description: This file defines the 'ProductConfigWrapper' class in the OFBiz framework, which manages product configuration data, including questions (config items), options, price calculations, and configuration state. It handles loading and saving product configuration, calculating prices, and managing user selections for product customization.

classes.name: ProductConfigWrapper
classes.description: Main class for managing product configuration, options, prices, and selections, facilitating product customization within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setConfigId
methods.description: Sets the configuration ID associated with this product configuration.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads a saved configuration based on configuration ID, applying stored selections.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets a specific configuration item and option as selected, identified by IDs and comments.

methods.name: resetConfig
methods.description: Resets all non-mandatory configuration options to their default or unselected state.

methods.name: setDefaultConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration options to their default choices based on predefined defaults.

methods.name: getConfigId
methods.description: Returns the current configuration ID.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Returns the list of configuration questions/options.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the main product entity associated with this configuration.

methods.name: getTotalListPrice
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total list price based on selected options.

methods.name: getTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current total price considering selected options.

methods.name: getDefaultPrice
methods.description: Returns the default total price based on default selections.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if all mandatory configuration questions are answered.

methods.name: getItemOtion
methods.description: Retrieves a specific option for a question based on indices.

nested_classes.name: ConfigItem
nested_classes.description: Represents a configuration item/question, containing options and related attributes.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content (question text) for this configuration item.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content wrapper for question description.

methods.name: getConfigItem
methods.description: Returns the associated configuration item entity.

methods.name: getConfigItemAssoc
methods.description: Returns the related configuration item association entity.

methods.name: isStandard
methods.description: Determines if the config item is of type STANDARD.

methods.name: isSingleChoice
methods.description: Checks if the question is single choice.

methods.name: isMandatory
methods.description: Checks if the question is mandatory.

methods.name: isFirst
methods.description: Indicates if this is the first question.

methods.name: setFirst
methods.description: Sets whether this is the first question.

methods.name: addOption
methods.description: Adds an option to this question.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of options for this question.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the display text for the question.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the detailed description or long description.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if any option is selected.

methods.name: getSelected
methods.description: Returns the selected option if any.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default option for this question.

nested_classes.name: ConfigOption
nested_classes.description: Represents an option within a configuration item, including pricing and selection state.

methods.name: getConfigOption
methods.description: Returns the underlying configuration option entity.

methods.name: recalculateOptionPrice
methods.description: Recalculates the option's total price based on components and selections.

methods.name: getOptionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the option.

methods.name: getOptionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the option (overloaded for locale).

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns description of the option.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns description with locale.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the option ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Gets user comments for this option.

methods.name: setComments
methods.description: Sets user comments for this option.

methods.name: getListPrice
methods.description: Returns the list price of the option.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Returns the current price of the option.

methods.name: getOffsetListPrice
methods.description: Returns offset list price relative to default.

methods.name: getOffsetPrice
methods.description: Returns offset price relative to default.

methods.name: isDefault
methods.description: Checks if this option is the default.

methods.name: hasVirtualComponent
methods.description: Checks if the option has virtual components.

methods.name: isVirtualComponent
methods.description: Checks if a component is virtual.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if the option is currently selected.

methods.name: setSelected
methods.description: Sets the selection state.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the option is available.

methods.name: setAvailable
methods.description: Sets the availability state.

methods.name: getComponents
methods.description: Returns associated components.

methods.name: getComponentOptions
methods.description: Returns component options map.
